target.section: Canvas Agent Studio / Local AI Teammate foundation
target.boundary: deterministic local read+propose only; no provider, persistence, filesystem, network, Page IR/site mutation, browser, collaboration, scheduling, deployment, release, or A4 motion

findings.scenario: A valid typed assignment followed by a transport, HTTP, or invalid-envelope failure renders the assignment textarea with aria-invalid=true, so assistive technology attributes a non-field failure to valid user input.
findings.contractEffect: The accepted F-04 disposition reserved assignment aria-invalid for local assignment validation, but the retained test pins the opposite behavior.
findings.smallestSafeCorrection: Carry an error origin and set aria-invalid only for task-field validation; keep the alert in aria-describedby for all error kinds and add both positive and negative unit cases.

findings.lineOrSymbol: working roster radios and form implicit submission
findings.scenario: Fable infers that Enter on a focused roster radio can implicitly submit in Chromium; the radio then becomes natively disabled and focus may fall to BODY while the request is held.
findings.contractEffect: Potential second instance of the accepted F-08 focus-continuity defect, not exercised by the current E2E.
findings.smallestSafeCorrection: Reproduce in Chromium; if confirmed, block roster Enter implicit submission or keep the focused radio in a coherent aria-disabled state and add a live one-request/focus oracle.

findings.lineOrSymbol: roster error Try again and reloadRoster
findings.scenario: Activating Try again replaces the focused button with loading text, dropping focus to BODY; success or repeated error does not restore a coherent keyboard position.
findings.contractEffect: The roster recovery control does not meet the section's keyboard/focus contract.
findings.smallestSafeCorrection: Retain the retry control while loading with aria-disabled and a duplicate guard, or explicitly focus the loading/re-rendered status; prove the real browser path.

findings.lineOrSymbol: file path and the authority-packet digest proof path
findings.scenario: Two new evidence files cited by closure reviews do not begin with an OBX-AUTH-ATF-001 supportingEvidencePrefixes entry, all of which require the 2026-08-30-ai-teammate-foundation- prefix.
findings.contractEffect: Evidence placement falls outside the authorization's exhaustive traceability cage; the content remains non-authoritative.
findings.smallestSafeCorrection: Rename both artifacts into the authorized prefix and repoint every closure proof reference.

findings.scenario: A schema-valid 2,000-code-unit NUL task exceeds the canonical 8 KiB input budget and returns a five-key HTTP 200 envelope with proposal=null and a budget-exhausted receipt, but no retained route test protects that route-to-Canvas contract.
findings.contractEffect: The accepted F-04 route-coverage half and spec non-complete terminal acceptance path remain unproven at the adapter boundary.
findings.smallestSafeCorrection: Add a route regression test for the oversized canonical input and exact terminal envelope/receipt fields.

findings.lineOrSymbol: F-03/F-06 proof claims and canvas-contract live assertions
findings.scenario: The ledger says live Canvas checks prove eight static Idle rows, but the E2E has no Idle assertion; it also lacks the promised data-class help text and aria-describedby live checks.
findings.contractEffect: The correction record overstates the F-03 live oracle and omits the F-06 Canvas half.
findings.smallestSafeCorrection: Add the three live assertions or narrow the ledger to unit-only evidence.

findings.scenario: The three JSON error helpers omit Cache-Control while canonical architecture and threat-model prose state that responses are no-store.
findings.contractEffect: The documentation header claim is broader than current error behavior.
findings.smallestSafeCorrection: Use one shared no-store JSON response init for all three error helpers and add 403/400 header assertions, or narrow both docs.

findings.scenario: The collision test's Date.now spy is never restored because afterEach calls only vi.unstubAllGlobals; the following timing test runs under the frozen clock and its stoppedAt>=startedAt assertion becomes vacuous and order-dependent.
findings.contractEffect: A retained receipt-time oracle cannot fail and test isolation is incomplete.
findings.smallestSafeCorrection: Call vi.restoreAllMocks in afterEach in addition to vi.unstubAllGlobals, and prove the unfrozen clock in the following test.

audit.overreachAssessment: No capability overreach found. The corrected tree adds none of the prohibited runtime, mutation, collaboration, deployment, release, browser, or A4 capabilities. Site Advice retention is an existing separately governed surface, not a newly granted capability. Evidence-path placement is the only scope-cage deviation found.
audit.underreachAssessment: Fable considered F-01, F-02 within the claimed tool/View boundary, F-03 product labelling, F-05, F-07, and F-08 for the submit control closed. It identified R-01 through R-08 as the remaining current underreach or proof defects; collapse retention remains explicitly unclaimed.
audit.authorityAssessment: OBX-AUTH-ATF-001, its ready ticket status, and prohibited-capability boundary remain unchanged. The authority manifest is packetDigest-only and the supplied verifier receipt binds the current packet. Same-target final security and independent-verification gates remain open. Two evidence artifacts are outside the named supporting-evidence prefix.
audit.proofAssessment: Fable read the listed normative, implementation, test, harness, and closure surfaces with no commands, web, or delegation. It accepted the 4-file/28-test and 1440 live-run records as recorded rather than independently executed, judged the live focus/network/retention oracles substantive, and identified the missing or vacuous cases in R-01, R-05, R-06, and R-08.
residualRisks: Corrected-file hashes and the authority digest were recorded but not recomputed by the read-only reviewer.
Same-target security, dependency-diff, prohibited-capability, and independent-verification gates remain pending.
The strengthened Agent Studio live oracle has been recorded only at 1440 so far; 768 and 390 remain pending.
The client POST has no timeout or AbortController, so a hung local request can retain working state until run change or reload.
Workbench collapse still unmounts draft/result state and remains explicitly unclaimed.
Client receipt binding trusts the local route for output hashing.
The hidden retained Site Advice pane remains separately mutating and would need a new boundary if it ever portals UI.
The injected proposal callback remains a trusted in-process seam.
